
```{r}
# Install packages
install.packages(c("DBI", "RPostgres", "tidyverse", "broom"))

# Load libraries
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
#Connect to Postgres database
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname   = "long_covid_sdoh",
  host     = "localhost",
  port     = 5432,
  user     = "postgres",
  password = "*****" #My password removed
)

# Verify connection
dbListTables(con)
```

```{r}

# Generating the dataset to analyze
analytic_query <- "
SELECT 
    p.patient_id,
    p.race_ethnicity,
    p.age_group,
    c.fips_code,
    c.state_id,
    c.overall_svi_score,
    pe.income_bracket,
    pe.health_insurance_type,
    pe.employment_status,
    pe.education_level,
    ph.housing_tenure,
    ph.missed_rent_payment,
    ph.eviction_risk_flag,
    pfs.food_scarcity_status,
    pfs.used_food_assistance,
    st.survey_phase,
    lcc.had_acute_covid,
    lcc.long_covid_flag,
    lcc.activity_limitation_level,
    -- Composite SDoH Vulnerability Score (0-3)
    (
        CASE WHEN pe.income_bracket LIKE '%Less than $25,000%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN ph.missed_rent_payment = TRUE OR ph.eviction_risk_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN pfs.food_scarcity_status LIKE '%not enough%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS vulnerability_score
FROM patients p
JOIN surveys_taken st 
    ON p.patient_id = st.patient_id
JOIN long_covid_cases lcc 
    ON st.survey_response_id = lcc.survey_response_id
LEFT JOIN patient_economics pe 
    ON p.patient_id = pe.patient_id
LEFT JOIN patient_housing ph 
    ON p.patient_id = ph.patient_id
LEFT JOIN patient_food_security pfs 
    ON p.patient_id = pfs.patient_id
LEFT JOIN counties c 
    ON p.fips_code = c.fips_code;
"

# Execute query and pull into R 
df_raw <- dbGetQuery(con, analytic_query)

# Disconnect from database
dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
# Prepare dataset for statistical modeling
df_model <- df_raw %>%
  # Filter to respondents with valid outcome data
  filter(!is.na(long_covid_flag)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Outcome variable as binary integer / factor
    long_covid_binary = if_else(long_covid_flag == TRUE, 1, 0),
    
    # 1. Income (Reference: Highest Income Bracket)
    income_bracket = factor(income_bracket),
    income_bracket = relevel(income_bracket, ref = "$200,000 and above"),
    
    # 2. Race / Ethnicity (Reference: White alone, non-Hispanic)
    race_ethnicity = factor(race_ethnicity),
    race_ethnicity = relevel(race_ethnicity, ref = "White alone, non-Hispanic"),
    
    # 3. Age Group (Reference: 18-29)
    age_group = factor(age_group),
    age_group = relevel(age_group, ref = "18-29"),
    
    # 4. Housing Insecurity Flag
    housing_insecure = if_else(missed_rent_payment == TRUE | eviction_risk_flag == TRUE, 1, 0),
    
    # 5. Food Insecurity Flag
    food_insecure = if_else(str_detect(food_scarcity_status, "not enough"), 1, 0),
    
    # 6. Education (Reference: Bachelor Degree or Graduate Degree)
    education_level = factor(education_level),
    education_level = relevel(education_level, ref = "Bachelor Degree"),
    
    # 7. Vulnerability Score as both Continuous & Factor
    vulnerability_score_factor = factor(vulnerability_score, levels = 0:3)
  )

# Inspect structure
glimpse(df_model)
```

```{r}
library(car)
library(scales)

# Model 1: Multivariable SDoH Domain Model
model_sdoh <- glm(
  long_covid_binary ~ income_bracket + 
                      food_insecure + 
                      housing_insecure + 
                      health_insurance_type + 
                      race_ethnicity + 
                      age_group + 
                      education_level,
  data   = df_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# Model 2: Cumulative SDoH Vulnerability Score Model
model_cumulative <- glm(
  long_covid_binary ~ vulnerability_score_factor + 
                      race_ethnicity + 
                      age_group + 
                      education_level,
  data   = df_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
```

```{r}
# Tidy and format Model 1 results
table_sdoh_or <- tidy(model_sdoh, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    aOR      = round(estimate, 2),
    CI_Lower = round(conf.low, 2),
    CI_Upper = round(conf.high, 2),
    p_formatted = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(term, aOR, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, p_formatted)

# Tidy and format Model 2 results
table_cumulative_or <- tidy(model_cumulative, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    aOR      = round(estimate, 2),
    CI_Lower = round(conf.low, 2),
    CI_Upper = round(conf.high, 2),
    p_formatted = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(term, aOR, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, p_formatted)

# View formatted tables
print(table_sdoh_or, n = 30)
print(table_cumulative_or)
```

```{r}
# Calculate VIF for Model 1
vif_results <- car::vif(model_sdoh)
print(vif_results)
```

```{r}
#Preparing data for Forest Plot
forest_data <- table_sdoh_or %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(term, "income_bracket") |
    str_detect(term, "insecure") |
    str_detect(term, "health_insurance")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    term_clean = str_remove_all(term, "income_bracket|health_insurance_type"),
    term_clean = fct_reorder(term_clean, aOR)
  )

# Plot Forest Plot
ggplot(forest_data, aes(x = aOR, y = term_clean)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper), height = 0.25, color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "#e74c3c", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title    = "aOR for Long COVID Risk by SDoH Factor",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for Race/Ethnicity, Age Group, and Education Level",
    x        = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y        = "SDoH Predictor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
